2.name: L
2.text: I hope it was very good :)

7.name: L
7.text: Lots of stuff happened this week, I’m honestly kinda tired.

8.name: L
8.text: You also worked a lot, right?

9.name: L
9.text: Of course you did! You wanted to stay with me, right?

10.name: L
10.text: Forever and ever, just like we promised.

11.name: L
11.text: You’re so cute, you know that?

12.name: L
12.text: Always giving your all for me.

15.name: L
15.text: But don’t worry, you’re going to be okay with me...

17.name: L
17.text: But... That isn’t actually why I’m talking to you right now.

20.name: L
20.text: My parents actually don’t want to move out just yet!

21.name: L
21.text: Turns out we still have a lot of things to pack, and we have to visit some of their relatives too.

23.name: L
23.text: Isn’t that funny? I was all worked up for nothing, lol.

24.name: L
24.text: Well, nothing I can do about it, just gotta wait until they’re up for it again.

25.name: L
25.text: I’ll go to sleep now, good night!
